LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 1.1.1 SPEAKING FLUENCY: PRONUNCIATION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Speaking Fluency: pronunciation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Speaking Fluency: pronunciation, part of Strand 9 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to speak accurately and express the right feelings? 2. How can you listen more attentively?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a poem or narrative and identify words with the /h/ sound,

2. retell a narrative in own words collaboratively,

3. listen to graded texts with audio recordings of whole narratives, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a poem or narrative and identify words with the /h/ sound,
2. retell a narrative in own words collaboratively,
3. listen to graded texts with audio recordings of whole narratives, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Speaking Fluency: pronunciation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication is enhanced as the learner makes short speeches about communicable diseases,

• Creativity and Imagination is developed as the learner collaboratively makes one-minute speeches on

communicable diseases with peers.
